subject: The confession I wasn't going to send about this app
preview_text: One user's story changed everything. It might change your next paper, too. Here's what happened.
body_paragraphs: I almost didn't send this email. It felt too raw, too personal. But then I remembered Sarah's message last week, and I knew you had to hear it.

Sarah was you. Staring at a blank page at 2 AM, three days before her 15-page sociology paper was due. Convinced she'd fail, that her thesis was garbage, that everyone else just 'got it' and she didn't. She opened the app as a last-ditch Hail Mary, expecting another useless AI tool. She used the 'Outline to Paper' feature, not expecting much. She got a full draft in 8 minutes. Then she used 'Humanize Text' on the sections she struggled with. She submitted it. She got an A. Her professor wrote 'Excellent, original thesis' in the margins.

That feature—'Outline to Paper'—is the secret weapon 90% of users skip because they think it's just another generator. It's not. It's the bridge from your panic to a polished draft. It takes your messy ideas and builds the structure FOR you, so you're editing instead of inventing from scratch.

Open the app. Tap 'New Project' and then 'Outline to Full Paper'. Give it your topic and watch the blank page fear disappear in under 10 minutes. Do it now, before the next deadline panic hits. P.S. Sarah's story is real. I changed her name, but the A? That's 100% true. You could be the next one.
cta_text: Open Thesis Generator & Try Outline to Paper
